business_problem: City's own growth necessitated a move away from its legacy on-premises enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and disconnected service solutions to Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, and Field Service to streamline workflows and optimize operations and service delivery in its US market.
solution_summary: City FM built its Microsoft solution to improve employee-productivity and operational workflows. City's own growth necessitated a move away from its legacy on-premises enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and disconnected service solutions to Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, and Field Service to streamline workflows and optimize operations and service delivery in its US market. Key components included Power BI delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Dynamics 365 Finance delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Although the project is still underway, team members in every department from executive leaders to help desk representatives are already noticing improvements in daily business processes, and they appreciate the intuitive dashboards that put so much information at their fingertips.

solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, narrative summaries, and self-service analytics to decision makers.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Finance
solution_components.role: Standardizes finance processes, controls, and transactional workflows in the cloud.
